title: Take up
subtitle: 開始、投入、培養、從事——究竟是哪一種 take up？
description: 開始、投入、培養、從事——究竟是哪一種 take up？

words.note: 最常見、最中性的說法。表示某個活動、習慣、課程或行動開始了。

exercises.original: She decided to take up jogging three mornings a week.
exercises.zh: 她決定開始每星期三個早上慢跑。
exercises.upgrade: She decided to start jogging three mornings a week.

options.explanation: — 最中性、自然地表示開始慢跑。
— 太正式，而且通常指較具責任性的任務或培訓。
— 常用於正式進入職業或領域。
— 適合方法、制度、習慣，不直接接 jogging。
— 表示持續追求，語氣比原句更強。

exercises.original: He took up learning the guitar during the summer holiday.
exercises.zh: 他在暑假期間開始學結他。
exercises.upgrade: He started learning the guitar during the summer holiday.

options.explanation: — 可表示參與，但不如 start 自然地表示起點。
— 適合較大型、較長期計劃。

words.note: 和 start 很接近，但稍微正式，常用於學習、工作、活動或某段過程的開始。

exercises.original: She took up studying economics after changing her degree programme.
exercises.zh: 她轉換學位課程後開始修讀經濟學。
exercises.upgrade: She began studying economics after changing her degree programme.

options.explanation: — 稍正式而自然地表示開始學習。
— 會變成「開始對經濟學感興趣」的口語意味。
— 可說 enter the field of economics，但不能直接替代此句結構。

exercises.original: The students will take up laboratory work in the second semester.
exercises.zh: 學生將在第二學期開始實驗室工作。
exercises.upgrade: The students will begin laboratory work in the second semester.

options.explanation: — 簡單表示活動的正式起點。

words.meaning: 開始對……產生興趣；投入某活動
words.note: 口語用法，表示開始接觸某個興趣、活動、音樂、運動或領域，並逐漸喜歡或投入其中。

exercises.original: I took up jazz after a friend played me several classic albums.
exercises.zh: 朋友播了幾張經典唱片給我聽後，我開始喜歡上爵士樂。
exercises.upgrade: I got into jazz after a friend played me several classic albums.

options.explanation: — 不是正式進入爵士樂行業。
— 很自然地表示開始對某種音樂產生興趣。
— 不能自然表示喜歡某種音樂。
— 表示認真追求，不只是開始喜歡。

exercises.original: She took up running after joining a group of colleagues who trained together.
exercises.zh: 她加入一群一起訓練的同事後，開始投入跑步。
exercises.upgrade: She got into running after joining a group of colleagues who trained together.

options.explanation: — 口語地表示開始接觸並投入跑步。
— 可說 adopted a running routine，但不能直接替代。
— 表示突然強烈開始，不符合語氣。

words.meaning: 開始學；學會一點；順便培養
words.note: 表示開始學習某種技能、語言、習慣或活動，常帶有「逐漸學會」或「不是非常正式地開始」的感覺。

exercises.original: He took up some basic Japanese while living in Osaka.
exercises.zh: 他住在大阪期間學會了一些基礎日語。
exercises.upgrade: He picked up some basic Japanese while living in Osaka.

options.explanation: — 表示在生活環境中逐漸學會一些語言，非常自然。
— 需要較正式的長期活動。
— 表示持續認真學習，語氣太強。

exercises.original: She took up basic coding skills by helping with a small website.
exercises.zh: 她透過協助製作一個小型網站，逐漸學會了一些基礎編程技巧。
exercises.upgrade: She picked up basic coding skills by helping with a small website.

options.explanation: — 表示開始採用某方法，不表示學會技能。
— 很適合非正式地逐漸學會技能。

words.note: 表示有目的地投入某個興趣、學科、事業或目標，通常比 start 更強調持續性和認真程度。

exercises.original: After discovering an interest in design, she took it up seriously as a career.
exercises.zh: 她發現自己對設計有興趣後，開始認真把它作為事業發展。
exercises.upgrade: After discovering an interest in design, she pursued it seriously as a career.

options.explanation: — 表示有目的、持續地投入某個興趣或事業。
— 太一般，沒有「認真持續投入」的意味。

exercises.original: He took up research in renewable energy after completing his doctorate.
exercises.zh: 他完成博士學位後開始持續從事可再生能源研究。
exercises.upgrade: He pursued research in renewable energy after completing his doctorate.

options.explanation: — 可說 enter the field，但這裡直接配 research 不自然。
— pursue research 是自然正式搭配。
— 需要 set about doing...，更偏向著手具體工作。

words.note: 較正式，表示參與某種活動、研究、討論、運動或行為。重點在實際參與其中。

exercises.original: Participants were encouraged to take up regular exercise.
exercises.zh: 參加者獲鼓勵開始並持續參與規律運動。
exercises.upgrade: Participants were encouraged to engage in regular exercise.

options.explanation: — 可以採用某個 exercise routine，但不能直接替代。
— 較正式地表示參與規律運動。

exercises.original: Students who take up group discussion tend to remember the material better.
exercises.zh: 參與小組討論的學生通常能更好地記住所學內容。
exercises.upgrade: Students who engage in group discussion tend to remember the material better.

options.explanation: — engage in discussion 是自然搭配。

words.note: 表示開始一項較大、較長、較重要的活動、計劃、旅程、學習或人生階段。帶有「正式展開」的意味。

exercises.original: At forty, she took up a three-year degree in architecture.
exercises.zh: 她四十歲時開始修讀一個三年制建築學學位。
exercises.upgrade: At forty, she embarked on a three-year degree in architecture.

options.explanation: — 太非正式，且像順便學會。
— 長期而重大的新學習階段很適合。
— 可說 entered university，但不是 degree。

exercises.original: The company took up an ambitious five-year modernisation programme.
exercises.zh: 公司開始推行一項雄心勃勃的五年現代化計劃。
exercises.upgrade: The company embarked on an ambitious five-year modernisation programme.

options.explanation: — 可以表示開始，但 embarked on 更突出大型長期計劃。
— 非常適合長期、重大計劃。
— 可採用方案，但這裡重點是展開整個計劃。

words.note: 表示接受並開始承擔某個工作、角色、責任或挑戰。重點不是興趣，而是責任或任務。

exercises.original: She took up responsibility for training the new staff.
exercises.zh: 她開始負責培訓新員工。
exercises.upgrade: She took on responsibility for training the new staff.

options.explanation: — take on responsibility 是固定而自然的搭配。

exercises.original: After the manager left, Daniel took up a much larger role in the project.
exercises.zh: 經理離職後，Daniel 在項目中開始承擔更大的角色。
exercises.upgrade: After the manager left, Daniel took on a much larger role in the project.

options.explanation: — role 一般不用 adopt 表示承擔。
— take on a role 是自然搭配。
— 需要接動名詞表示著手做事。
— 不夠正式，也不突出責任。
— 不能自然搭配 a role。

words.note: 較正式，表示開始並承擔一項通常需要努力、時間或責任的工作、研究、培訓或項目。

exercises.original: The researchers will take up a detailed review of the existing evidence.
exercises.zh: 研究人員將著手進行現有證據的詳細審查。
exercises.upgrade: The researchers will undertake a detailed review of the existing evidence.

options.explanation: — undertake a review 是正式而自然的搭配。

exercises.original: All supervisors must take up additional training before the new system is introduced.
exercises.zh: 所有主管都必須接受並進行額外培訓，然後才能推出新系統。
exercises.upgrade: All supervisors must undertake additional training before the new system is introduced.

options.explanation: — 可用於 studies，但 compulsory training 更適合 undertake。
— 表示正式承擔並完成培訓。
— 需接 doing，且偏向開始處理任務。

words.note: 表示開始接受並使用某個方法、制度、習慣、策略或做法。

exercises.original: The family took up a healthier way of eating after the doctor’s advice.
exercises.zh: 聽取醫生建議後，這個家庭開始採用更健康的飲食方式。
exercises.upgrade: The family adopted a healthier way of eating after the doctor’s advice.

options.explanation: — 表示開始接受和實行新的生活方式。
— 只能表示開始，不能突出「採用」。

exercises.original: The school took up a new approach to teaching reading.
exercises.zh: 學校開始採用新的閱讀教學方法。
exercises.upgrade: The school adopted a new approach to teaching reading.

options.explanation: — 表示參與，不表示採用方法。
— adopt an approach 是自然搭配。

words.note: 表示開始進入某個職業、行業、專業領域或正式活動範圍。

exercises.original: She took up law after several years working in publishing.
exercises.zh: 她在出版業工作數年後投身法律界。
exercises.upgrade: She entered the legal profession after several years working in publishing.

options.explanation: — 可說 pursue a career in law，但這裡重點是正式進入行業。
— enter the legal profession 最自然。

exercises.original: He took up politics after years of campaigning for local causes.
exercises.zh: 他多年參與地方議題倡議後正式投身政治。
exercises.upgrade: He entered politics after years of campaigning for local causes.

options.explanation: — enter politics 是標準搭配，表示正式投身政治。
— 口語，也可能成立，但正式程度較低。

words.note: 表示開始認真處理某件具體事情或任務，常用 set about doing something。

exercises.original: Once the funding arrived, the team took up the task of rebuilding the website.
exercises.zh: 資金到位後，團隊開始著手重建網站。
exercises.upgrade: Once the funding arrived, the team set about rebuilding the website.

options.explanation: — set about doing something 表示開始實際處理某任務。
— 可表示開始，但沒有「動手處理」的感覺。

exercises.original: After identifying the problem, engineers took up finding a permanent solution.
exercises.zh: 工程師找出問題後，開始著手尋找永久解決方案。
exercises.upgrade: After identifying the problem, engineers set about finding a permanent solution.

options.explanation: — 表示立即開始處理一項具體問題。
— 是採用方案，不是尋找方案。
— 可用於大型 project，但這裡具體任務以 set about 更自然。

words.note: 非常正式的 begin/start。常見於官方通知、法律、工程、課程、程序或正式活動。

exercises.original: The new employees will take up training on 1 October.
exercises.zh: 新員工將於十月一日正式開始培訓。
exercises.upgrade: The new employees will commence training on 1 October.

options.explanation: — 有指定日期和正式培訓安排，適合官方語體。

exercises.original: Construction will take up after the final permit is approved.
exercises.zh: 最終許可獲批後，工程將正式展開。
exercises.upgrade: Construction will commence after the final permit is approved.

options.explanation: — 工程、程序、營運等正式開始常用 commence。
— 若說 activity picks up 是「加快」，不是「正式開始」。

words.note: 表示突然或充滿精力地開始某個動作，特別常用於說話、解釋、批評、故事或一段活動。

exercises.original: As soon as she sat down, she took up a detailed explanation of everything that had happened.
exercises.zh: 她一坐下便立即詳細講述所發生的一切。
exercises.upgrade: As soon as she sat down, she launched into a detailed explanation of everything that had happened.

options.explanation: — 適合長期計劃，不適合一段突然開始的解釋。
— 表示迅速而投入地開始長篇說話。

exercises.original: Without waiting for questions, the speaker took up a passionate defence of the proposal.
exercises.zh: 講者沒有等待提問，便立即熱烈地為方案辯護。
exercises.upgrade: Without waiting for questions, the speaker launched into a passionate defence of the proposal.

options.explanation: — 不表示突然開始長篇發言。
— 強調直接、有力度地開始講述或辯護。

falseSynonyms.zh: 一般開始不等於開始培養某活動 Start 可以用於任何開始；take up 很常用於新興趣、活動、課程、職責。
falseSynonyms.point: She started working at nine. She took up tennis last year.

falseSynonyms.zh: 開始感興趣不等於正式進入某領域 Get into 比較口語，常表示開始喜歡或參與；enter 常指正式進入職業或領域。
falseSynonyms.point: He got into jazz at university. He entered the music industry after graduation.

falseSynonyms.zh: 逐漸學會不等於正式開始 Pick up 常暗示非正式地學會某技能；take up 只需要表示開始做某個活動。
falseSynonyms.point: She took up Spanish classes. She picked up some Spanish while living in Madrid.

falseSynonyms.zh: 持續追求不等於單純開始 Start 只表示開始；pursue 通常表示有目標地持續投入。
falseSynonyms.point: He started painting last month. He decided to pursue painting seriously.

falseSynonyms.zh: 承擔責任不等於培養興趣 Take on 通常是接受角色、工作或責任；take up 常用於興趣或活動。
falseSynonyms.point: She took up swimming. She took on responsibility for the new team.

falseSynonyms.zh: 承擔正式任務不等於一般參與 Undertake 常表示負責完成一項正式任務；engage in 只表示參與某活動。
falseSynonyms.point: The researchers undertook a national survey. Participants engaged in group discussion.

falseSynonyms.zh: 採用方法不等於單純開始 Adopt 表示開始接受和使用某方法、習慣、制度或策略。
falseSynonyms.point: The company began reviewing its procedures. The company adopted a new review system.

falseSynonyms.zh: 正式開始不等於突然投入 Commence 非常正式而中性；launch into 強調立即、強烈地開始。
falseSynonyms.point: Construction commenced in April. He launched into an angry speech.
